title: VELOCITI: Benchmarking Video-Language Compositional Reasoning with Strict Entailment

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing scatter plots of entailment scores and comparing the accuracy on positive versus negative captions to detect models' predisposition to output 'Yes' regardless of actual alignment.

Evaluating models in a multiple-choice setup (Option A vs. Option B) and measuring the difference in accuracy depending on which position holds the correct caption to detect preference for a specific letter.
Testing the benchmark using text-only (blind) models and single-frame models to verify that tasks cannot be solved using only language priors or static visual cues.
